opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage as a get-rich-quick business in which money can be doubled through participation and new-member activity. He explicitly connects new members buying 300 TRX with later profit, then states that money can be doubled through Forsage. That structure makes recruitment and network participation central to the promised returns. The title reinforces the same framing by calling it a “Get Rich Quick” business involving Forsage and TRON. The discussion of multiplying money quickly presents TRX as another rapid-wealth opportunity, rather than neutral market analysis.
